claims.text: Hallucinations and non-factual responses generated by LLMs can be detected by examining the uncertainty of the LLM in its response.
Uncertainty quantification methods for LLMs can be applied to chatbot and textual applications.
Uncertainty quantification methods for LLMs can be applied to embodied artificial intelligence applications in robotics.

evidence.description: Previous work has shown that hallucinations and other non-factual responses generated by LLMs can be detected by examining the uncertainty of the LLM in its response to the pertinent prompt.
Furthermore, we highlight applications of uncertainty quantification methods for LLMs, spanning chatbot and textual applications...
...to embodied artificial intelligence applications in robotics.

methodologies.name: Taxonomic literature survey of LLM uncertainty quantification
methodologies.description: A comprehensive survey and categorization framework that synthesizes existing methods, features, strengths, weaknesses, and applications of uncertainty quantification for LLMs.

limitations.text: Large language models have a propensity to generate hallucinations, which are plausible, factually-incorrect responses expressed with striking confidence.

future_work.text: Investigating open research challenges in the uncertainty quantification of LLMs.
